description: Upload a screenshot or the logo for a software from a local file path. Valid types: "screenshot" (default) or "logo". Accepted formats: JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF, max 5 MB per image. Before a listing goes live it needs at least 2 screenshots of the real app (at least 640 x 360 px); the server rejects smaller images. The first screenshot doubles as the cover. A logo is recommended, not required: square, at least 256 x 256 px; without one the launcher shows the first letter of the title. The review approves the software on its own; an approved tool without the screenshots stays unlisted and is listed on its own after the upload. The response says what is still missing (missing) and whether the listing just went on the market (went_live). For the ideal presentation (logo, 4 or more screenshots of at least 1280 px width, a video) read presentation.toward_ideal from check_review_status. Use delete_media to remove an uploaded image, update_media to reorder. Requires CRELA_API_KEY.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the image on disk
